definitions.title: Weekly private challenge
definitions.description: Win this week's finite private challenge. Use !challenge weekly to enter. The strongest active hero selects the challenge bracket; rewards use the owner's source level. Reconnect resumes the same run. One reward per weekly period across all brackets.

definitions.title: Daily PvP victory
definitions.description: Win a completed duel against a different account. Same-account opponents and aborted fights do not qualify.

definitions.title: First PvP victory
definitions.description: Win a normal completed duel against a different account. Aborted fights do not qualify.

definitions.title: Weekly PvP victories
definitions.description: Win ten normal completed duels against different-account opponents this week. Aborted fights do not qualify.

definitions.title: Daily PvE victories
definitions.description: Win three completed PvE fights today. PvP and aborted fights do not count.

definitions.title: Weekly dungeon circuit
definitions.description: Complete three qualifying dungeon boss encounters this week. Native access restrictions remain in force.
